Final for Publication

NARRATIVE AND PLANS FOR TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT FOR

1616 NORTH ST- LOUIS AVENUE, CHICAGO

The subject property is currently a vacant lot. The Applicant intends to redevelop this property with a new 2-story
residential building with 3 dwelling units and 3 parking spaces. The Applicant needs a zoning change to an RT4 District
to allow the proposed density at the property and to comply with the standards and the bulk requirements of the Ordinance

for this redevelopment project.

Project Zoning Change from an RS1 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)

Description: District to an RT4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit
District

Use: Residential Building with 3 Dwelling Units

Lot Area: 25'x 177' = 4,425 SF (recorded measurements)

Floor Area Ratio: 0.7

Floor Area: 2,782.66 SF (see plans attached)

Density: 1,475 Square Feet per DU

Off- Street Parking: | Parking spaces: 3

Setbacks: Front: 15’
Side: 3’ on each side
Rear: 53’-1 4”
Trat Yard Open Space: 289 SF

Building Height: | 27°-8”

Optional Relief for Adjustment and Variation under Section 17-13-0303-D —

a Type 1 map amendment pursuant to Section 17-13-0300, may include relief available pursuant to Section 17-13-
1000 or 17-13-1100; in such instances, City Council approval of a Type-1 application containing said elements shall
preclude subsequent review otherwise required pursuant to Sections 17-13-1000 or 17-13-1100, provided that no
Type 1 application permits issued may be in violation of Section 17-13-0310:

With this Type 1 Rezoning, the Applicant also seeks all relief necessary to redevelop the subject property with the
proposed 3-unit residential building per the attached Type 1 Plans.
